description: This file contains service layer classes for user and note management in a web application, handling operations such as user registration, authentication, and CRUD operations on notes with authorization checks.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class for user registration and authentication operations.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing notes with authorization.

methods.name: User register(email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password.

methods.name: User authenticate(email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password.

methods.name: Note create_note(user_id: int, title: str, content: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates a new note for a user.

methods.name: Note get_note(user_id: int, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note if the user has access.

methods.name: Note update_note(user_id: int, note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of a note if the user has access.

methods.name: None delete_note(user_id: int, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note if the user has access.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Note],int,int] list_notes(user_id: int, page: int, per_page: int)
methods.description: Lists notes for a user with pagination info.

ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate(email: str, password: str) -> User:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def list_notes(user_id: int, page: int, per_page: int) -> Tuple[List[Note], int, int]:$/
